subject: ghost-haven
label: One hundred and forty-six
field: Ghost Haven · why the surfaces are that high
from: A house grown into Bella's shape; surface heights unrecorded
to: EVERY SURFACE EXCEPT THE BEDS AND THE TUBS IS AT BELLA'S HIP HEIGHT, ON PURPOSE, FOR THE BELLA CONFIGURATION.
note:
THE COUNT IS RECORDED: SERA FUCKED BELLA 146 TIMES DURING ARC 4, the Construction Arc, on the bones the women had laid and christened beam by beam. The Southern Woods watched all of it.

THE ARCHIVE ALREADY HAD THE SHAPE — Ghost Haven is Belladonna Vargas's ass, PLIANT PAWG BUBBLE, two wings as cheeks. WHAT IT DID NOT HAVE IS THAT THE LAND ALSO TOOK NOTES ON THE HABIT. Counter, island, workbench, every ledge and every hood: set to the clearance of the shortest woman in the house rather than the tallest, in a household that averages six feet, because the land decided what those surfaces were for.

BEDS AND TUBS ARE THE EXCEPTIONS. Everything else is an invitation with a purpose-built height.

AND THE VERTICAL RUNS THE OPPOSITE WAY. THE DOORFRAMES ARE EIGHT FEET. Nobody in this house ducks, because BRYN ERIKSSON DOES NOT DESIGN A FRAME SHE HAS TO DUCK THROUGH — the Archive had Sera dipping her chin under a beam in her own kitchen, which reads as texture and is in fact an insult to the woman who drew the plans. GENEROUS OVERHEAD, DELIBERATE UNDERHAND.

AND IT CORRECTS THE ARCHIVE OUT LOUD: BRYN DID NOT BUILD THIS COMPOUND. Bryn gave the land in Arc 2. The girls raised the frame with their own hands. THE WOODS GREW THE REST. The Archive has now made the one-builder error three separate times — Marianne and the Lucky Hammer, Bryn and the forge, Bryn and the house — and it is always the same shape of mistake: ONE OWNER INSTEAD OF TWO, ONE BUILDER INSTEAD OF A FAMILY AND A FOREST.
